name: community-marketing
description: Community marketing without astroturfing. Before someone connected to a product posts in a forum, subreddit, Discord or Slack community or launch site they don't run, check the draft against the venue's own subreddit rules or forum rules (pasted, or one public rules page) and get a verdict: Post, Revise, Ask the moderators first or Do not post. Or learn how to promote there before writing anything. Map how to take part in communities you already belong to, set up an ambassador program or employee-advocacy programme with disclosure wording and incentive rules for US, UK and EU audiences, read your own community's health from an export or counts, and write community guidelines, moderation rules and incident handling. Not legal advice. Refuses fake accounts, undisclosed promotion, vote or review manipulation and member scraping.
